title.value: A Distributional Analysis of Sampling-Based Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the primary subject and methods of the paper, focusing on distributional analyses in reinforcement learning.
title.quote: A Distributional Analysis of Sampling-Based Reinforcement Learning Algorithms

analysis.description: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of reinforcement learning algorithms using a distributional approach, focusing on constant step-sizes. It demonstrates the efficacy of this approach in establishing the convergence of various algorithms, such as TD(λ) and Q-Learning, by showing their update rules are contractive in the space of distributions. This analysis simplifies existing proofs of convergence and provides additional insights into the behavior of these algorithms.

type.justification: The paper provides a theoretical analysis and proof of convergence for various algorithms rather than conducting empirical experiments.
